riley: Heads-up: observed a spike in per-model burn during a canary for tenant=helios. Warmup tokens seem to be inflating the model heatmap (~120k warmup tokens). Anyone else seen this? :eyes:
mike: Yep, we tag warmup invocations in telemetry (`is_warmup=true`) but our heatmap aggregation currently sums total_tokens so warmup lands in the model bucket.
ash: UX ask: can we add an explicit toggle in the console heatmap to hide/show warmup, and show an estimated warmup charge in the rollout preview? PMs keep getting surprised.
oliver: Runtime note: two warmup flowsKV prefetch and synthetic probes. We can add header `x-rw-warmup:1` and `x-warmup-id:<uuid>` to make attribution explicit. We'll also emit `warmup_sample_rate` for probes to avoid telemetry deluge.
mike: Backend plan: split aggregation into model_tokens_total and model_warmup_tokens. Expose API flag `include_warmup=true|false` for console endpoints and add timeseries `model_cost_excluding_warmup`. Also provide a preview query for rollout modal.
nash: Tooltip copy proposal: "Warmup tokens are system-initiated requests (prefetches, KV priming) triggered during deployments and routing to cold variants. They are billable but shown separately to avoid misleading model comparisons." Short + long variants ready.
revenue-bot: Created ticket RW-5088: "warmup telemetry split + heatmap toggle" (assignee: unassigned)
riley: Proposed owners: mike (backend/API), ash (UX copy + mock), oliver (runtime headers). I'll attach a small mock and the SQL preview when available.
mike: Proto SQL to preview warmup per variant: ```sql
SELECT variant_id, sum(warmup_tokens) as warmup_tokens, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens, 
round((sum(warmup_tokens)::decimal / nullif(sum(total_tokens),0)) * 100,2) as pct_warmup
FROM invocation_tokens
WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY variant_id
ORDER BY warmup_tokens DESC;```
oliver: Plan: land header + sampling PR by Tue next week; will coordinate schema names with Mike.
nash: I'll drop the Figma link once the mock is ready.
riley: Thanks team  tagging RW-5088 for followups. :thumbsup:
